prOriginal.nota: calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy (default branch main). Found with gh pr list search 'backup codes in:title'; headRefOid equals benchmark head 54486a05, squash-merged as a308075b. disable.ts later moved to apps/web/app/api/auth/two-factor/totp/disable/route.ts (#19826); authorize() was extracted to authorizeCredentials in the same next-auth-options.ts.

feat-2fa-backup-codes-cal-com#01.reason: PR #25563 'fix: simplify credentials provider authorization flow' removed the `if (user.password?.hash && !credentials.totpCode)` guard and now always runs verifyPassword before the backup-code/TOTP branches. Today authorizeCredentials throws IncorrectEmailPassword on a wrong password regardless of totpCode, so backup code plus dummy totpCode no longer bypasses the password.

feat-2fa-backup-codes-cal-com#02.reason: EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx on main still only calls setStep(SetupStep.DisplayBackupCodes) on success and calls onEnable() only from the backup-codes-close button. The settings view (apps/web/modules/settings/security/two-factor-auth-view.tsx) still passes onOpenChange={() => setEnableModalOpen(!enableModalOpen)}, so dismissing skips the viewer.me invalidation in onEnable.

feat-2fa-backup-codes-cal-com#05.reason: apps/web/playwright/login.2fa.e2e.ts on main still clicks backup-codes-copy and only waits for toast-success, with the original '// TODO: check clipboard content' comment still in place.

feat-2fa-backup-codes-cal-com#07.reason: authorizeCredentials on main still decrypts user.backupCodes, finds the index with indexOf, nulls it and writes back with prisma.user.update({where:{id:user.id}}) with no version/compare-and-set or transaction, so concurrent use of the same code is still possible.

feat-2fa-backup-codes-cal-com#12.reason: The backup-codes-copy handler in EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx on main is unchanged: navigator.clipboard.writeText(...) is not awaited and showToast(t("backup_codes_copied"), "success") fires immediately.

feat-2fa-backup-codes-cal-com#16.reason: The endpoint moved to the app router (apps/web/app/api/auth/two-factor/totp/disable/route.ts, #19826) but still does `if (user.twoFactorEnabled && body.backupCode)` then body.backupCode.replaceAll("-", "") with no string type check, so a truthy non-string still throws instead of a 400.

feat-2fa-backup-codes-cal-com#sncc-01.reason: authorizeCredentials on main still matches with backupCodes.indexOf(credentials.backupCode.replaceAll("-", "")) over the decrypted codes; no constant-time comparison was introduced.
